{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers
df_loyal = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute the number of loyal customers and converted loyal customers
n_loyal = len(df_loyal)
n_converted = df_loyal['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate = df_loyal['converted'].mean()

# Print the values used in evidence
print(f'n_loyal = {n_loyal}')
print(f'n_converted = {n_converted}')
print(f'conversion_rate = {conversion_rate}')"}
